description: Retrieve the full body of a licensed article using a buyer API token (opedd_buyer_live_* canonical; opedd_buyer_test_* for sandbox). Requires OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN env var (create one at opedd.com/licenses after purchasing). Works for per-article Human republication licences and for licence orders: AI answers monthly and client display return full text. Your self-serve buyer API key reads articles under every order your account holds — no separate order token is needed. AI answers pay-per-request (including the self-serve licence) does NOT retrieve articles: it answers 403 SEARCH_ONLY_LICENCE — ask a question with search_passages instead. Articles the publisher stopped licensing answer 403 ARTICLE_EXCLUDED. The publisher must have content delivery enabled and must have pushed content for the article. The response includes author, language, word_count, content_hash, image_urls, canonical_url and tags. On pre-2026-05-14 historical articles, optional fields (author/language/image_urls/canonical_url/tags) may be NULL. NULL means 'data unavailable for this article', NOT 'explicitly empty' — treat as data-missing when filtering; do not interpret as anti-match.

article_id.description: The Opedd article UUID to retrieve content for

buyer_token.description: Buyer API token (opedd_buyer_live_* or opedd_buyer_test_*). Falls back to OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN env var.

name: get_content
title: Read a licensed article
